scenes.title: The idea cloud
scenes.accessibleDescription: A messy problem can suggest several very different products.

scenes.title: Ask for a mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: A readback arranges your thoughts so you can correct them.

scenes.title: Behavior, not a feature
scenes.accessibleDescription: Describe who acts, what they do, and what they see.

scenes.title: Fact, guess, unknown
scenes.accessibleDescription: Label what was checked and what still needs investigation.

scenes.title: The alignment gate
scenes.accessibleDescription: The owner corrects the readback until the experience matches their intent.

scenes.title: A prompt to begin
scenes.accessibleDescription: Ask the agent to hold the idea, organize it, and wait for correction.

scenes.title: One conversation
scenes.accessibleDescription: Owner and agent move from a rough problem toward a shared understanding.

scenes.title: Correct the mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: A mistaken readback is an invitation to clarify scope.

scenes.title: Show the journey
scenes.accessibleDescription: Lay out a sequence someone can observe from beginning to end.

scenes.title: Keep claims honest
scenes.accessibleDescription: A form in source code does not prove a live submission is saved.

scenes.title: Translate the metaphor
scenes.accessibleDescription: A tidy inbox is a feeling; the owner decides which behaviors it means.

scenes.title: Save the readback
scenes.accessibleDescription: A short dated record gives the next session a reliable starting point.

scenes.title: Practice the mirror
scenes.accessibleDescription: Ask a friend or a new agent to explain the journey back to you.
